checks.basis: One owned QA launch and one stdio client. Nine functional JSON-RPC requests match EXECUTION_PLAN, with only rename/nonplanar/close private controls. No retry loop, timing series or algorithm resampling.

StdioClient(command,cwd,output,absolute_deadline), call, inspect_images, compare_same_capture and finish signatures align. Positive responses use result/isError=false and bad active-query responses use result/isError=true. 600s outer deadline is integer ns; service request_budget_s=90 and socket timeout=30 are accepted finite scalar types.

Controller bootstrap uses installed manifest, then normal active_observation import. Service config project_root is binding.install_root. Child stdio receives the same binding/bootstrap and live expected identity.

Original deadline and Popen poll are checked before marker read, original deadline checked again before successful return. Only missing/incomplete JSON waits. Complete wrong PID/deadline/source/fixture markers fail subsequent assertions.

Each log handle is immediately appended. Main try/finally retains client and QA Popen. Client finish, private close, initial QA wait, kill, post-kill wait, actual handle close and each log close independently preserve errors. Nonzero or unknown termination makes batch failed.

Uses reviewed final StdioClient e9274fd6. Reader startup exceptions enter cleanup; independent cleanup stages continue after errors; active stdout reader defers buffer close and records unconfirmed status.

Cold ordinary/rename/nonplanar outputs receive QA-only direct core comparisons from saved actual capture and index cameras. They perform no extra capture/raster and report separate extra QA parse/index counts.

Expected ordinary2/repeat0/rename2/nonplanar0 new rasters. Same-source repeat requires zero parse/prepare/raster. Final intent count must be four under the reviewed hard eight-slot wrapper. Local images are readback, with no model inference.

review_process_note: An initial reviewer AST expression check expected two literal append statements. The actual equivalent for-loop appends immediately and was accepted after reading it; no case was run.
review_scope: Static source and AST only. No case, candidate, test, camera, raster, Blender or subprocess acceptance launched by reviewer. Runtime source/config/binding and actual exit still require the one root-owned frozen execution.
